facts.text: Louisiana Christian University is the only Baptist, Christian liberal arts college in the state of Louisiana.

sources.title: Meet LCU – Louisiana Christian University
sources.quote: Louisiana Christian University is the only Baptist, Christian liberal arts college in Louisiana.

facts.text: LCU uses a no-fee, flat-rate tuition model to remove unexpected fee costs and keep tuition accessible.

sources.title: Meet LCU – Louisiana Christian University
sources.quote: Through scholarships applied to a no-fee, flat-rate tuition, the University works to remove financial barriers and keep Christ-centered education within reach.
